instagram.headline: How to place a trellis in My Garden
instagram.body:
The standard Trellis is a one-tile My Garden decoration. It unlocks at 3,250 lifetime Care and costs 50 Care each time you place one. Choose an open grid tile, open your inventory, and place the Trellis.

Build a garden in Basil: https://basilcommunitygarden.com/?utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=basil_daily_20260804&utm_content=trellis_diagram

reddit.headline: A game-accurate guide to placing a trellis in Basil's My Garden
reddit.body:
This diagram uses the actual My Garden renderer and catalog values. The standard Trellis occupies one grid tile, unlocks at 3,250 lifetime Care, and costs 50 Care to place. The rose-covered trellis is a separate later item with a larger footprint and different cost.

Would another object guide be more useful for paths, water features, or habitat items?
